== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''PySINDy''' identifies differential equations from data by sparse regression over a library of candidate functions: it seeks the fewest terms that reproduce the measured time derivatives, <math>\dot{X} \approx \Theta(X)\,\Xi</math> with <math>\Xi</math> sparse. Variants handle partial differential equations (PDE-FIND) and noisy data (weak forms). It is written in Python in the style of scikit-learn.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM ==
* '''Lagrangian / Action (3/10):''' Finds equations of motion, not actions; variational structure has to be imposed through custom libraries.
* '''Field / PDE (6.5/10):''' PDE-FIND and weak-form libraries identify partial differential equations from data in space and time.
* '''Relativity (1/10):''' Nothing specific to relativity.
* '''Quantum / Data (8/10):''' Learning from data is the core.

== Integration Pipeline ==
# '''Identify''' equations from the data with no action assumed.
# '''Ask whether they admit a Lagrangian''': test them against the Helmholtz conditions of the inverse problem of the calculus of variations, or compare them with the Euler-Lagrange equations of a Lagrangian found by [[The Principia Machina/Tools/LagrangianNN|a Lagrangian network]] or [[The Principia Machina/Tools/PySR|PySR]].
# '''Read agreement as support''' for the action hypothesis, and disagreement as a pointer to dissipation, a missing variable or a biased library.

== Status, Licence and Limits ==
* '''Status:''' Active. Version 2.1.0 on 8 January 2026 (PyPI), 2.0.0 on 22 August 2025.
* '''Licence:''' MIT.
* '''Home:''' https://github.com/dynamicslab/pysindy
* '''Limits:''' Results depend heavily on the candidate library and on how derivatives are estimated from noisy data. A sparse model is not necessarily the true one.

== On the Principia Machina ==
A tool runs only where the sponsor installed and bound it, and what it returns is untrusted input, vetted before use; its numbers are never values of the site's calculator, TPC. A law it finds is not a register record: it can enter only as the kernel of a new container, and the data it was fitted to can never be the outside value of that law's verification. See [[The Principia Machina/Agent/Tools|Agent/Tools]] and [[The Principia Machina/Tools/Operator's guide|the operator's guide]].
